release_notes:
Localize admin side menu + labels for 6 languages; add customer language selector

Customer dashboard
- Added a language selector to the customer header (left of the profile menu), using
  the existing switchlanguage.php mechanism (?ln=CODE). Shows the current language's
  flag + native name and lists all supported languages; styled for the dark header and
  responsive (name hides on very small screens).

Admin side menu localization
- The menu labels come from the DB (tbl_gf_forms.Form / tbl_gf_form_type.FormType) in
  English, so they couldn't use the $BE_* constants. Added a translation layer
  (admincp/include/php/menu_i18n.php + gf_menu_tr()) wired into formsmgmt.php, with
  quality translations of the menu categories and items for Spanish, French, German,
  Italian, Portuguese and Russian. Other languages fall back to English.

Backfilled labels -> real translations
- Replaced the English-fallback placeholders (from the previous release) with proper
  translations for the same six languages, for the labels that map to menu terms —
  only where the label was still an untranslated English fallback, so existing
  translations are never overwritten. Remaining backfilled labels and other languages
  keep the English fallback and can be translated next.
